# google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector

Manages the Workload Identity Connector on an existing Oracle Cloud VM Cluster.

~> **Note:** Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state; it does not disable the Workload Identity Connector on the Cloud VM Cluster. To disable the connector, set `enabled = false` and apply before removing the resource. Deleting the parent `google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster` automatically cleans up the connector without being blocked by this resource.


To get more information about CloudVmClusterIdentityConnector, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/oracle/database/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.cloudVmClusters)
* How-to Guides
    * [Create VM clusters](https://cloud.google.com/oracle/database/docs/create-clusters)

## Example Usage - Oracledatabase Cloud Vm Cluster Identity Connector Basic


```hcl
resource "google_oracle_database_cloud_exadata_infrastructure" "infra" {
  cloud_exadata_infrastructure_id = "my-exadata"
  display_name                    = "my-exadata displayname"
  location                        = "europe-west2"
  project                         = "my-project"

  properties {
    shape         = "Exadata.X9M"
    compute_count = "2"
    storage_count = "3"
  }

  deletion_protection = true
}

resource "google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster" "vmcluster" {
  cloud_vm_cluster_id    = "my-instance"
  display_name           = "my-instance displayname"
  location               = "europe-west2"
  project                = "my-project"
  exadata_infrastructure = google_oracle_database_cloud_exadata_infrastructure.infra.id
  odb_network            = "projects/my-project/locations/europe-west2/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork"
  odb_subnet             = "projects/my-project/locations/europe-west2/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork/odbSubnets/my-odbsubnet"
  backup_odb_subnet      = "projects/my-project/locations/europe-west2/odbNetworks/my-odbnetwork/odbSubnets/my-backup-odbsubnet"

  properties {
    license_type    = "LICENSE_INCLUDED"
    ssh_public_keys = ["ssh-rsa  nobody@google.com"]
    cpu_core_count  = "4"
    gi_version      = "19.0.0.0"
    hostname_prefix = "hostname1"
  }

  deletion_protection = true
}

resource "google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector" "my_identity_connector" {
  cloud_vm_cluster = google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster.vmcluster.cloud_vm_cluster_id
  location         = "europe-west2"
  project          = "my-project"
  enabled          = true
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `enabled` -
  (Required)
  Whether the Workload Identity Connector is enabled for the Cloud VM Cluster.
  Set to `true` to enable the connector or `false` to disable it.

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the Cloud VM Cluster.

* `cloud_vm_cluster` -
  (Required)
  The ID or full resource name of the Cloud VM Cluster, in the format
  `{cloud_vm_cluster}` or
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/cloudVmClusters/{cloud_vm_cluster}`.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/cloudVmClusters/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 60 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 60 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


CloudVmClusterIdentityConnector can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/cloudVmClusters/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}`
* `{{location}}/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import CloudVmClusterIdentityConnector using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    cloudVmCluster = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import CloudVmClusterIdentityConnector using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/cloudVmClusters/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}"
  to = google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), CloudVmClusterIdentityConnector can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/cloudVmClusters/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}
$ terraform import google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}
$ terraform import google_oracle_database_cloud_vm_cluster_identity_connector.default {{location}}/{{cloud_vm_cluster}}
```
